elsewhere.note: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,
